description: A change records one edit to a Lix row, including what changed, when it changed, and which row was affected.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Account whose active session authored this change.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the change was recorded (set via `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` at write time).

columns.name: row_ref
columns.description: Opaque reference to the public relation row this change applies to; NULL for private engine rows.

columns.name: file_id
columns.description: Filesystem-scoped file identifier when the change belongs to a file; NULL for engine-internal rows (commits, branches, settings).

columns.name: metadata
columns.description: Optional user-provided JSON metadata attached to the change; NULL when nothing was supplied.

columns.name: origin_key
columns.description: Optional caller-provided origin key for the write that produced this change; NULL when the writer did not provide one.

columns.name: schema_key
columns.description: Schema identifier of the row (e.g. `lix_file_descriptor`, `lix_commit`, or a user-registered key).

columns.name: snapshot_content
columns.description: Row JSON body at this change; NULL represents a tombstone (deletion).
